bai: Bai 19 in an trong Excel: Print Preview, Page Setup, Margins, Fit to Page, Page Break, Print Titles

cong_thuc.ten: Mo Print Preview + gan nut nhanh
cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Ctrl+P hoac Quick Access Toolbar > tich Print Preview and Print
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Preview xem truoc phan trang truoc khi in. Gan len Quick Access de 1 click mo nhanh nhu Save/Undo.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Click mui ten Quick Access > tich Print Preview > click bieu tuong kinh lup. Hoac Ctrl+P mo preview sheet Ke hoach KD.
cong_thuc.loi_hay_gap: Nhan Print ngay ma khong Preview nen lech trang, mat tieu de. Gan nut nhung tim khong thay vi nham tab.

cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Print > Printer: chon may LAN hoac Microsoft Print to PDF > Print
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Chon dich den: may giay that hoac may ao PDF de luu file dien tu gui mail.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Printer = Microsoft Print to PDF > Print > dat ten Bai19.pdf > Save ra Desktop.
cong_thuc.loi_hay_gap: Chon nham may offline nen job ket; luu PDF nhung quen doi ten ghi de file cu.

cong_thuc.ten: Pham vi in: Selection / Active Sheets / Entire Workbook
cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Settings: Print Active Sheets | Print Entire Workbook | Print Selection
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Active Sheets: sheet dang dung; Entire Workbook: ca file (vd 36 trang); Selection: chi vung dang boi den.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Boi den tieu de + 10 thu thuat > Print Selection chi in vung do. Muon in ca file 3 sheets chon Entire Workbook.
cong_thuc.loi_hay_gap: De Entire Workbook khi chi muon 1 sheet nen in thua 36 trang ton giay. Chon Selection nhung quen boi den truoc nen nut mo.

cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Pages: nhap From [1] To [10]; in 1 trang: [7] den [7]
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Mac dinh in het; nhap from-to de in nhap, in test 1 trang.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Entire Workbook 36 trang > Pages 1-10 chi in 10 trang dau de kiem tra.
cong_thuc.loi_hay_gap: Nhap 7-8 khi muon 1 trang 7 nen thua 1 trang. Nhap chu thay vi so gay loi.

cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Print Settings / Page Layout > Orientation: Portrait (doc) / Landscape (ngang)
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Bang rong nhieu cot chon Landscape cho vua; danh sach dai it cot chon Portrait.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Bang Ke hoach rong chon Landscape; danh sach NV dai chon Portrait.
cong_thuc.loi_hay_gap: De Portrait cho bang 10 cot nen co nho, cat trang. Doi huong sau khi can le lam le lech lai.

cong_thuc.ten: Show Margins keo le truc quan
cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Preview goc duoi phai > tich Show Margins > keo cham den tren/dưới/trai/phai
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Hien duong le de keo bang chuot ngay tren preview, nhanh hon nhap so.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Tich Show Margins > keo le tren xuong de tiet kiem 1 trang.
cong_thuc.loi_hay_gap: Keo le qua sat mep may in khong in duoc (ngoai vung printable). Tat Show Margins nen khong thay de keo.

cong_thuc.cong_thuc: File > Options > Advanced > Display > Ruler units: Centimeter > OK
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Mac dinh inch (8.5x14") kho can theo chuan VN; doi cm de nhap 2cm trai/phai quen thuoc.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Doi xong Page Setup hien cm; Custom Margins nhap 2cm.
cong_thuc.loi_hay_gap: Nham don vi nen nhap 2 tuong 2cm nhung thuc 2 inch (~5cm) le qua to. Doi tren may khac khong luu theo file.

cong_thuc.ten: Can le Margins + can giua trang (Center)
cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Page Setup > Margins: Top/Bottom/Left/Right/ Header/Footer + Center on page: Horizontally + Vertically
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Nhap so le cu the; tich Center de bang nam giua giay doc + ngang, dep khi bang nho hon giay.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Margins 2cm + tich Center Horizontally + Vertically: bang Ke hoach nam giua trang A4.
cong_thuc.loi_hay_gap: Chi center ngang quen center doc nen bang dinh len dau trang. De le 0 lam may in cat mat chu.

cong_thuc.ten: Fit Sheet on One Page (co ve 1 trang)
cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Print Settings: No Scaling > Fit Sheet on One Page | hoac Page Setup > Page > Scaling: Fit to 1 page wide by 1 tall
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Co toan bo ve dung 1 trang. Tien nhung du lieu dai se chu be ti, chi dung khi lech 1-2 cot/hang.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Ke hoach KD 4 trang > Fit Sheet on One Page con 1/1 trang de gui sep xem tong.
cong_thuc.loi_hay_gap: Fit ca bao cao 29 trang ve 1 trang chu be nhu kien khong doc duoc. Quen tra ve No Scaling cho lan in sau.

cong_thuc.ten: Page Break Preview keo gom trang
cong_thuc.cong_thuc: View > Page Break Preview > keo duong xanh (ran ngat trang) sat bien phai + duoi > Normal de ve
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Nhin thay vung Page1..4 va ran xanh. Keo ran ve bien tuong duong Fit thu cong, chu to hon Fit auto. Ctrl+Z hoan tac keo lo.
cong_thuc.vi_du: 4 vung xanh > keo duong doc sang phai + duong ngang xuong sat bien > Ctrl+P thay 1/1 trang.
cong_thuc.loi_hay_gap: Keo nham duong dut (break tu dong) thay vi xanh dam. Quen ve Normal/Gridlines nen tiep tuc lam viec trong che do Break kho chiu.

cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Page Setup > Header/Footer > Custom Header/Footer: Left/Center/Right + Insert Page Number (&Page) / &File / &Date
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Left/Center/Right la 3 o dau-cuoi trang. &Page tu tang so trang; ket hop text co dinh vd 'Ga Excel'. Xem truoc de can.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Custom Header Left='Ga Excel', Right=Insert Page Number. Footer Center='Luu hanh noi bo'. Preview thay ten trai + so trang phai.
cong_thuc.loi_hay_gap: Go tay so 1 thay vi &Page nen cac trang deu so 1. Header dai che mat tieu de bang.

cong_thuc.ten: Chen / xoa ngat trang Page Break
cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Chon hang/cot can ngat > Page Layout > Breaks > Insert Page Break | Remove Page Break | Reset All Page Breaks. Kiem tra bang Page Break Preview.
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Tach du lieu (trang 1) va chart (trang 2) rieng. Chon ca hang 17 thi ngat ngang; chon cot thi ngat doc.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Chon hang 17 > Insert Page Break -> Page1 du lieu, Page2 chart; Ctrl+P thay 1/2, 2/2.
cong_thuc.loi_hay_gap: Chon o le thay vi ca hang nen break lech. Chen qua nhieu break thu cong lam file in vun; quen Reset khi muon ve auto.

cong_thuc.ten: Lap tieu de moi trang (Print Titles)
cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Page Layout > Print Titles > Sheet tab > Rows to repeat at top: $1:$4 (vd $4:$4) | Columns to repeat at left
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Bao cao 29 trang van thay hang tieu de Doanh thu/Khu vuc/Vung/Tinh o moi trang. Chon ca $1:$4 neu co tieu de lon + tieu de cot.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Rows $4:$4 lap hang tieu de; Ctrl+P sang trang 2 van thay tieu de cot, khong phai doan.
cong_thuc.loi_hay_gap: Chon sai hang (hang data thay vi tieu de) nen lap nham. Mo Print Titles tu Preview sai sheet nen nut mo (phai mo tu sheet can lap).

cong_thuc.ten: Vung in Print Area (Set / Clear / Add)
cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Boi den vung > Page Layout > Print Area > Set Print Area | Add to Print Area | Clear Print Area
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Gioi han chi in vung quan trong (vd 10 thu thuat + tieu de). Clear de tro lai in het khi xong.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Set vung 10 thu thuat -> Ctrl+P chi thay vung do; Clear de bo khi in bao cao khac.
cong_thuc.loi_hay_gap: Set nhieu lan khong Clear nen vung in cu van giu, in thieu. Quen Add ma Set de ghi de vung cu.

cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Page Layout > Sheet Options > Gridlines: tich View + Print; Headings: tich Print. (View > Gridlines chi la hien thi)
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Mac dinh preview trang tinh khong ke o. Tich Print moi in ke o va tieu de dong (1,2,3) cot (A,B,C) de doi chieu.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Tich Gridlines Print -> ban in co ke o de cham cong; tich Headings de thay A,B,C giup huong dan nhap lieu.
cong_thuc.loi_hay_gap: Nhin thay luoi tren man hinh tuong se in (nhung chua tich Print) nen ban in trang tron. In headings cho bao cao gui sep lam thua A,B,C.

cong_thuc.ten: An hien duong Page Break + Scaling canh bao
cong_thuc.cong_thuc: File > Options > Advanced > Display options for this worksheet > bo/tich `Show page breaks`. Scaling: giam % vua doc (khong Fit mu).
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Duong cham cham sau khi dung Break Preview gay kho chiu thi tat. Neu Fit be qua thi giam con 2 trang + giam le thay vi 1 trang.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Bo Show page breaks > OK; mo lai file khong con duong cham. Bao cao dai chuyen Fit 1x2 trang thay vi 1x1.
cong_thuc.loi_hay_gap: Tat Show page breaks roi tuong mat break that (break van con). Co giam % thu cong + Fit cung luc gay xung dot ti le.

cau_hoi.cau: Gan nut Print Preview o dau?
cau_hoi.A: Quick Access Toolbar (mui ten tren cung)
cau_hoi.giai_thich: 1 click mo preview nhanh nhu Save/Undo.

cau_hoi.cau: Phim tat mo Print Preview/Print la gi?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Ctrl+P la chuan in/preview.

cau_hoi.cau: Khong co may in giay thi chon gi de demo/luu?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: PDF luu ra file thay vi giay.

cau_hoi.cau: Mac dinh Settings in cai gi?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Chi in sheet hien tai.

cau_hoi.cau: Muon in ca file 3 sheets (36 trang) chon gi?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Entire Workbook gom het sheets.

cau_hoi.cau: Muon chi in vung dang boi den chon gi?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Chi in o dang chon; phai boi den truoc.

cau_hoi.cau: In trang 1-10 nhap the nao?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Gioi han from-to de in nhap/test.

cau_hoi.cau: In rieng dung trang 7 nhap the nao?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: From=To=7 in dung 1 trang.

cau_hoi.cau: Bang rong nhieu cot nen chon huong gi?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Ngang vua bang, dep, tiet kiem cat trang.

cau_hoi.cau: Hien duong le de keo bang chuot o dau?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Hien cham den de keo le truc quan.

cau_hoi.cau: Mac dinh don vi le trong Page Setup la gi?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Dau nhay kep la inch.

cau_hoi.cau: Doi inch sang cm o dau?
cau_hoi.D: File > Options > Advanced > Display > Ruler units: Centimeter
cau_hoi.giai_thich: De can le chuan cm VN.

cau_hoi.cau: Nhap so le cu the (2cm) o dau?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Nhap so + center tai day.

cau_hoi.cau: De bang nho nam giua giay thi tich gi?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Can giua trai-phai va tren-duoi.

cau_hoi.cau: Fit Sheet on One Page de lam gi?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: No Scaling > Fit Sheet; chi khi lech it.

cau_hoi.cau: Rui ro lon nhat khi Fit bao cao 29 trang ve 1 trang?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Can nhan: chia 2 trang + giam le thay vi Fit mu.

cau_hoi.cau: Xem vung ngat trang o che do nao?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Hien Page1-4 + duong xanh ran ngat.

cau_hoi.cau: Keo gom 4 trang ve 1 trang trong Break Preview lam the nao?
cau_hoi.B: Keo duong xanh sat bien phai + duoi
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Keo ran xanh ve bien tuong duong Fit thu cong.

cau_hoi.cau: Chen ngat trang ngang tai hang 17 de tach du lieu/chart lam the nao?
cau_hoi.C: Chon hang 17 > Page Layout > Breaks > Insert Page Break
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Chon ca hang roi Insert; kiem tra bang Break Preview.

cau_hoi.cau: Lap lai hang tieu de moi trang in o dau?
cau_hoi.D: Page Layout > Print Titles > Rows to repeat at top ($4:$4 hoac $1:$4)
cau_hoi.giai_thich: 29 trang van thay tieu de Doanh thu/Khu vuc...

cau_hoi.cau: File 29 trang muon trang 2 van thay tieu de cot thi set the nao?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Lap dung hang tieu de, khong lap hang data.

cau_hoi.cau: Gioi han chi in vung 10 thu thuat thi lam the nao?
cau_hoi.B: Boi den vung > Print Area > Set Print Area
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Set de chi in vung can; Clear khi xong.

cau_hoi.cau: Xoa vung in de tro lai in binh thuong thi lam gi?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Clear go bo gioi han vung in.

cau_hoi.cau: Ban preview khong thay ke o du man hinh co luoi thi vi sao?
cau_hoi.D: Vi chua tich Sheet Options > Gridlines Print (View chi la hien thi)
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Man hinh thay chua chac in; phai tich Print.

cau_hoi.cau: Muon ban in co ke o de cham cong thi tich gi?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Tich Print moi in ke o.

cau_hoi.cau: Muon in ca ten cot A,B,C va so hang de huong dan thi tich gi?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Headings Print in tieu de dong/cot.

cau_hoi.cau: Header Left 'Ga Excel' + so trang phai set o dau?
cau_hoi.C: Page Setup > Header/Footer > Custom: Left text, Right &Page
cau_hoi.giai_thich: &Page tu tang; go tay so 1 thi cac trang deu 1.

cau_hoi.cau: Loi go tay so trang 1 thay vi &Page gay hau qua gi?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Phai dung &Page de tu tang.

cau_hoi.cau: Duong cham cham ngat trang hien sau khi dung Break Preview thi tat o dau?
cau_hoi.A: File > Options > Advanced > bo Show page breaks
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Bo tich de an duong cham kho chiu.

cau_hoi.cau: Keo le qua sat mep giay gay loi gi?
cau_hoi.B: May in cat mat chu (ngoai vung printable)
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Giu le toi thieu theo may in.

cau_hoi.cau: Huong xu ly khi Fit ve 1 trang chu be qua?
cau_hoi.C: Chia 2 trang + giam le + thu Portrait/Landscape thay vi co 1 trang
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Uu tien doc duoc hon la gom 1 trang.

cau_hoi.cau: De tach du lieu trang 1 va bieu do trang 2 thi kiem tra o dau sau khi Insert Break?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Preview xac nhan tach dung.

cau_hoi.cau: Muon in thu 10 trang dau cua file 36 trang de kiem tra thi lam the nao?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Gioi han Pages de test truoc khi in het.

cau_hoi.cau: Mo Print Titles bi mo (khong click duoc) thi nguyen nhan la gi?
cau_hoi.B: Do mo tu Preview sai sheet; phai mo tu dung sheet can lap
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Print Titles mo theo sheet hien tai.

cau_hoi.cau: Them vung in moi ma khong mat vung cu thi dung gi?
cau_hoi.C: Add to Print Area thay vi Set
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Add giu vung cu, Set ghi de.

cau_hoi.cau: Center Vertically quen tich thi bang nam o dau?
cau_hoi.D: Dinh len dau trang thay vi giua doc
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Can tich ca ngang + doc neu muon giua that.

cau_hoi.cau: Undo keo duong xanh Break lo thi bam gi?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Hoan tac keo ran.

cau_hoi.cau: Bao cao gui sep co ke o + tieu de lap + so trang thi can bat nhung gi?
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Combo chuan cho bao cao nhieu trang.

cau_hoi.cau: Luu bang ra PDF de gui mail thi thao tac dung la gi?
cau_hoi.C: Printer Print to PDF > Print > dat ten > Save
cau_hoi.giai_thich: PDF giu dinh dang, gon nhe.

cau_hoi.cau: Kiem tra cuoi truoc khi bam Print la gi?
cau_hoi.D: Ctrl+P xem preview: huong, le, fit, titles, area, header du chua
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Preview 10 giay tranh in sai ton giay.
